total.description: The total number of activities in the collection.

itemReference.description: The fully qualified reference of the object.

objectId.description: The identifier of the object that generated this activity.

objectUrl.description: A link to the object that generated this activity.

discardedTime.description:
The date-time representing the time when a user discarded the activity.
This property will only be present if the `activityManagementStatus` of
the alarm or audit for the activity is `discarded`.

creationTime.description: The date-time for when the activity was detected.

spaces.description:
The collection of spaces associated with the object on which the
activity occurred.

equipment.description:
The collection of equipment associated with the object on which the
activity occurred.

activityManagementStatus.description:
The activity management status of this alarm. The values of this
property are:

- `pending` - Indicates a user has not yet acted upon the alarm.
- `acknowledged` - Indicates a user recognized and viewed the alarm.
- `discarded` - Indicates a user acted upon or dismissed the alarm.

description.description:
A more detailed description of the triggered alarm, either
describing the object that triggered the alarm or the alarm itself.

acknowledgedTime.description:
The date-time representing the time when this activity message was
acknowledged.

isAckRequired.description:
Indicates whether the alarm can be acknowledged. You will get an
error response if you attempt to acknowledge an alarm for which this
property is `false`.

type.description:
The type of alarm.

The values for this property come from the `alarmValueEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `alarmValueEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/alarmValueEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

category.description:
The authorization category of the object when the alarm was
generated


The values for this property come from the `objectCategoryEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `objectCategoryEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/objectCategoryEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

annotationsUrl.description: A link to the annotations available on the alarms.

annotationsCount.description: The total number of annotations associated with this alarm.

signedAnnotationsCount.description: The total number of MVE Annotations associated with this audit.

triggerValue.description: The value of the attribute of the object that triggered the alarm.

alarmGeneratorObject.description: Reference information to the object which generated the alarm.

associatedGraphic.description: Reference information for the graphic associated with the alarm.

reference.description:
Provides the fully qualified reference to the graphic associated
with the alarm.

url.description: A link to the graphic resource associated with the alarm.

alias.description:
The object alias to apply to the graphic for which this alarm is
associated to.

aliasUrl.description:
A link to the graphic resource associated with the alarm, with
the alias information included.

itemReference.description: The fully qualified reference of the object.

objectId.description: The identifier of the object that generated this activity.

objectUrl.description: A link to the object that generated this activity.

discardedTime.description:
The date-time representing the time when a user discarded the activity.
This property will only be present if the `activityManagementStatus` of
the alarm or audit for the activity is `discarded`.

creationTime.description: The date-time for when the activity was detected.

spaces.description:
The collection of spaces associated with the object on which the
activity occurred.

equipment.description:
The collection of equipment associated with the object on which the
activity occurred.

activityManagementStatus.description:
The activity management status of the audit. The values of this property
are:

- `pending` - Indicates a user has not yet acted upon the audit.
- `discarded` - Indicates a user has acted upon or dismissed the audit.

description.description: A more detailed description of the audited action.

originApplication.description:
The Metasys application or component that generated the audit.


The values for this property come from the `auditOriginAppEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `auditOriginAppEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/auditOriginAppEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

actionType.description:
The type of action audited by the system.

The values for this property come from the `auditActionTypeEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `auditActionTypeEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/auditActionTypeEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

parameters.description: Parameters passed for commands or writes.

user.description: The username of the user that initiated the action.

signature.description: RELEASES: 15.0 and later\ The signature associated with the activity.

fullName.description: The full name of the person signing the annotation.

reason.description: The reason for the action requiring an annotation.

classLevel.description:
The level at which the system generated the audit.

The values for this property come from the `auditClassesEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `auditClassesEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/auditClassesEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

status.description:
The status of the action.

The values for this property come from the `statusEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `statusEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/statusEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

preData.description: The old value before the command or edit.

postData.description: The new value after the command or edit.

annotationsUrl.description: A link to the available annotations available for the audit.

annotationsCount.description: The total number of annotations associated with this audit.

signedAnnotationsCount.description: The total number of MVE Annotations associated with this audit.

effectivePermissions.description: A collection of permissions that apply to the activities in `items`.

items.description:
Indicates the ability for the current user to take action on a given
activity.

id.description: The ID of the activity that these permissions apply to.

canAcknowledge.description:
Indicates whether the current user can acknowledge the activity. This
property will only be present for an alarm activity.

canDiscard.description: Indicates whether the current user can discard the activity.

canAnnotate.description:
Indicates whether the current user can annotate the activity. This
property will only be present if the current platform supports
annotations.

next.description:
A link to the next set of results. This link contains the continuation
token used to retrieve the next set.

self.description: A link to this list of activities.

alarmBacnetProps.description: RELEASES: 14.1 and later\ BACnet calls this type of record an event notification. The properties under this key are specific to BACnet event notifications. This property will only be present on a BACnet Advanced Workstation site.

deviceId.description: The BACoid of the device where the event initiated.

objectId.description: The BACoid of the object initiating the event.

notificationClassId.description: The notifier class that was responsible for distributing the alarm.

bacnetObjectType.description: Will always be the Notification Class

timestamp.description:
For devices with a clock this property will specify the time or date and
time of the alarm. For devices without a clock this will convey a
sequence number that indicates the relative ordering of alarms. A BACnet

Check for the existence of the properties `time`, `dateTime` and
`sequenceNumber` to determine which is used for an instance of alarm.

time.description:
The local time the alarm was generated. (The time is local with
respect to the device that generated the alarm.) An example
value is `"19:49:23"`

sequenceNumber.description:
The sequence number associated with this alarm. An example is
`345`

dateTime.description:
The local date and time when the alarm was generated. (The value
is local with respect to the device that generated the alarm.)
An example value is `"2024-10-11T19:49:23"`

notifyType.description:
The type of notification. This indicates if the notification is an
alarm, an event or an acknowledgement. An example value is
`bacNotifyTypeEnumSet.bacNotifyAlarm`


The values for this property come from the `bacNotifyTypeEnumSet` enumeration.
Find the definition of `bacNotifyTypeEnumSet` at the relative URL of `/schemas/enums/bacNotifyTypeEnumSet`.

**See also:**
* [Get enumeration](#operation/getEnumerationAsJsonSchema) for more information on retrieving an enumeration.

anyDataTypeSchemaRequired.description: A variant data type that can hold a value of any of the built-in data types of the Metasys object model.

equipment.description:

occurred.

id.description: The identifier of the equipment instance.

itemReference.description: The fully qualified reference of the equipment instance.

equipmentName.description: The name of the equipment instance.

shortName.description: The name of the mapped point.

equipmentUrl.description: The URL to the equipment instance.

nullableObjectReferenceDefinition.description: A reference to an object in the system.

objectReference.description: The fully qualified referenced of the object.

space.description: A space associated with the object on which the activity occurred.

itemReference.description: The fully qualified reference of the space.
